checks.label: A decimal answer, such as 1.73 (2 decimal places), is not exact: at area 3 the side is written √3 with ≈ 1.73 beside it, and squaring 1.73 back gives 2.9929, not 3

To write the side length of a square whose area is not a whole number times itself, we use the square root symbol: at every area from 1 to 25 the side is drawn √area long and written √area, or as the whole number at 1, 4, 9, 16 and 25
A surd is an expression that includes a square root, cube root or other root symbol: on every screen, each side or edge that is not a whole number is written with √ or ∛, and each whole one without
At areas 1, 4, 9, 16 and 25 the unit squares fill the square exactly; at every other area some of it is in pieces, and the whole squares and the pieces add up to the area
A cube's edge is the cube root of its volume: at every volume from 1 to 125 the edge drawn, used three times, gives the volume, and the unit cubes fill it exactly only at 1, 8, 27, 64 and 125
The tilted square keeps half of each of the 4 unit squares, so its area is 4 × ½ = 2, and its side, one unit square's diagonal, is √2
The square of area 48 splits into 16 squares of area 3, 4 along each side, so its side √48 is 4√3; 8 squares of area 6 make the same area but lie as 2 rows of 4, not a square
Squares of 9 and 16 make 25, whose side is 5, while their sides end to end make 3 + 4 = 7; the square of side 7 holds 9 + 16 + 12 + 12 = 49
x² = 36 has two answers, 6 and −6, both on the number line, while the side √36 is 6; x² = 48 is solved by 4√3 and −4√3, and the pick 4√3 alone shows only one
Every line of working on every screen adds up, at every area from 1 to 25 and every volume from 1 to 125 too, and each "not" value differs

Each puzzle accepts only its right answer: squared or cubed back, the right answer gives the area or volume and every wrong one does not; before an answer the side reads ?, after it the right side, and a slip of a length is drawn at that length
Every demonstration has arrived within 5 s of its screen opening, nothing starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer and press within 3 s, and the 8 × 6 try within 3.5 s
